posts.text: Israel’s Coordinator of Government Activities in the Occupied Palestinian Territories (COGAT) announced that a shipment of blankets and winter clothing would not be allowed into Gaza after Israeli occupation authorities confiscated it at the Karem Abu Salem crossing. The decision comes as hundreds of thousands of displaced Palestinians face harsh winter conditions, with more than 70,000 tents flooded by heavy rainfall and severe shortages of essential shelter supplies.

🔻 PSG vs Roma: Predicted lineups, team news, and Champions League preview 📌 PSG vs Roma: predicted lineups, injury updates, Champions League statistics, recent form, kick-off time, and everything you need to know ahead of the match. Paris Saint-Germain will attempt to extend their flawless Champions League campaign when they welcome Roma to the Parc des Princes. The defending European champions have won all four of their league-phase matches, scoring a record-breaking 20 goals, and could establish another milestone in European football against Gian Piero Gasperini's side. ​ Roma arrive in the French capital with considerable attacking momentum following a 5-1 victory over Parma, inspired by four goals from Donyell Malen. However, their inconsistent European performances remain a concern. PSG, meanwhile, must cope with the absence of Désiré Doué and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia as Luis Enrique's side seek a 13th consecutive victory across all competitions. ​ Both managers have several selection decisions to consider ahead of Wednesday's meeting, with injuries affecting both squads. ​ PSG predicted XI: Safonov, Hakimi, Zabarnyi, Pacho, Hernandez, Neves, Vitinha, Ruiz, Akliouche, Mayulu, Fran. ​ Roma predicted XI: Vazquez, Mancini, Balerdi, Hermoso, Molina, Cristante, De Roon, Wesley, Soule, Mora, Malen. ​ Luis Enrique has suffered another significant setback in attack after Désiré Doué sustained an anterior cruciate ligament injury during PSG's victory over Nice. The French forward is set to miss the remainder of the season, joining Khvicha Kvaratskhelia on the long-term injury list. ​ Doué's absence represents a considerable loss for the European champions. Having registered 45 shots and created 31 chances, he has been one of PSG's most dangerous attacking players. ​ Alessandro Longani is also sidelined with a thigh injury, although the recent return of Ousmane Dembélé provides Enrique with additional attacking options. ​ Fabian Ruiz is expected to feature in midfield after contributing directly to goals in each of his last four Champions League appearances, including scoring in his two most recent matches. ​ Gasperini received a welcome boost during the international break as Paulo Dybala and first-choice goalkeeper Mile Svilar returned from injury. Lorenzo Pellegrini, however, remains unavailable with a thigh problem. ​ Devyne Rensch is struggling with an adductor injury, while Leonardo Balerdi is doubtful after suffering an ankle problem. ​ Brazilian wing-back Wesley has strengthened his case for a starting place after providing three assists against Parma, despite only entering the match in the second half. ​ Donyell Malen is expected to spearhead Roma's attack. The Dutch forward leads the Serie A scoring charts with 12 goals and has scored in each of his last three Champions League appearances. ​ Roma injured and doubtful players: ​ Paris Saint-Germain will face Roma on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, at the Parc des Princes in Paris.
